This sorghum plot is small, only a quarter hectare, but sorghum is our main food here in Tigray and the rains can be poor. I will try to get some DAP from the cooperative if it arrives in time, but I cannot afford much, and I will spread manure from my oxen on the plot like every year. I will plant my own saved seed as I always do — the improved varieties are hard to find here and cost too much. My wife and I and the older children will do most of the weeding ourselves; I may bring one or two neighbors for a few days at weeding and harvest if the crop looks good.
